confidence_notes: I based the food and beer anchors on web-searched aggregated typical prices from nomad.watch, livingcost/nomads.com and travel guides. Those sources put Beerlao at about USD 1-2 and a local meal at about USD 1.5-3. A cappuccino at a tourist cafe is about 30,000 LAK, and a sit-down dinner for two is around USD 19 including beer. I did not search for cocktail and wine prices directly. I estimated them from how they usually compare with beer in Laotian tourist towns, so they are less certain, and imported wine in particular is priced variably. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and not from listings. Because of the July 2026 pricing window and LAK inflation, the USD values carry some uncertainty. The FX observation is the RBA rate for 18 November 2026, which a search result attributed to the RBA's own rate and RSS feed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Backpacker and adventure-tourism town in Laos. I used Luang Prabang (slightly more expensive) and Vientiane as the comparable cities and adjusted the prices down a little for Vang Vieng.
